intro: Juon ri-kōmmanmōn eak ekāāl. Ij lolōrjake jerbal in kōjparok server ASHIKA Network im laajrak in Minecraft server SABALISU, im ij kōmmane software in Minecraft server Storia.
about: Ij ekāāl wōt, ak aolep raan ij je code im ij kōmmōn wōt ñan an emman
Ij lolōrjake jerbal in kōjparok server eo aō make
Kajjitōk ko kōn jerbal ko aō ak technology rej ruwaj: ba wōt iọkwe ilo Discord
can_write: Ta eo ij maroñ je (barāinwōt code ko rejjab emman)
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: server jen 30 yen ilo juon allōñ
anw_p:
Juon jerbal in kōjparok ñan ro rekōnaan kōjerbal juon server ak rejjab maroñ kōjerbale elōñ mani.
Jino jidik, **jen 30 yen wōt ilo juon allōñ**.
sab_t: SABALISU: juon laajrak in Minecraft server
sab_p:
Kōdedeļọk Minecraft server eo am ilo laajrak eo im pukōt armej ñan kūrel ie.
Ejerbal ñan ri-kūrel ro rej pukōt juon server im ñan ri-lewaj ro rekōnaan kwaļọk server eo aer.
storia_t: Storia: software in server ñan Minecraft server ko reļļap
storia_p: Juon open-source fork in Folia ñan Minecraft 26.2. Ippān **Storia Cluster**, juon lal emaroñ jerbal ilo elōñ server ilo ejja juon iien, im ri-kūrel ro rej ito-itak ikōtaan er ilọkin loading screen.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: juon lal elōñ server rej kōjerbale, im kōkkeitak ko ikōtaan er rej encrypted
**Standby relay**: relay eo kein ka-ruo ej kōjparok juon kopi im ej bōk jikin eo kein ka-juon ñe ejako
**Linear format**: lal ej kōjerbal jimettan in jikin ilo disk
**RAM lal**, **Tick Guard**, juon plugin API ñan data ko rej kōjerbali ippān doon, im elōñ bar
